detail.emptyBody: Pick an NPC from the list, or open one from the map viewer, to see what it says and how often players talk to it.
detail.partialBody: This NPC runs its own method, which needs a player to run. The pages below are its lines and options read from the method's source in order, one per window it shows, with the methods it hands the talk to. Which page a player gets depends on their level, items, silver and so on, and text the script builds at run time shows its {holes}.
detail.opensShop: Opens its shop window ({{count}} items, from the client's Shop.dat).
